headline: Data Engineer at ICICI Lombard. Computer engineering graduate (2026) with Honours in Data Science.

points: Built scalable ETL pipelines with 100+ PL/SQL stored procedures and triggers, raising data integrity and processing accuracy by 18%.
Replaced manual extraction and refresh cycles with automated, schedule-driven Oracle workflows, cutting daily load times by 25%.
Encoded BI logic (dynamic KPIs, aggregated metrics, derived columns) into ETL workflows using PL/SQL analytical functions for enterprise dashboards.
Wrote automated reconciliation scripts to resolve sync anomalies between OLTP systems and the OLAP warehouse.
Designed a Medallion data model (Staging, Curated, Consumption) in dbt and Jinja-templated SQL for BI reporting in Domo and Sigma.
Built idempotent Apache Airflow pipelines moving high-volume data from Google Cloud Storage to Snowflake.
Supported the SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA migration: remediated legacy tables, updated transformations, validated for zero-defect production data.
Built a natural-language query interface in Retool AI so business teams could query databases without writing SQL.
Integrated the Tazama open-source fraud detection engine, porting core rule logic from TypeScript to Python.
Implemented 30+ transaction rules across P2P and P2B flows, reducing false positives and reaching 98.5% detection accuracy.
Added Google Maps API geolocation checks for real-time verification of transaction locations.
